port.class.warrior.blurb.value: Starts identified, hits hard, carries throwing stones.

port.class.mage.blurb.value: Weakest melee hit of the six - the staff wants to be charged and zapped.

port.class.rogue.blurb.value: Same bite as the Warrior, plus a cloak of shadows and throwing knives.

port.class.huntress.blurb.value: Weakest single hit, but bare-handed gloves swing twice as often.

port.class.duelist.blurb.value: A lighter blade than the Warrior’s, plus throwing spikes.

port.class.cleric.blurb.value: The cudgel itself is 40% more accurate than any other starting weapon.

port.hint.vault.value: A quiet vault. Something radiant waits in the dark.

port.hint.keys.value: move, F search, T special, E eat, Q quaff, R read, U upgrade, O save, P load

port.npc.ghost.offer.value: The ghost pleads: "A creature took my bones... please, slay it and bring them back."

port.npc.ghost.done.value: The ghost has moved on. There is nothing left to say.

port.npc.ghost.remind.value: The ghost whispers: "Please... find my bones..."

port.npc.ghost.reward.value: The ghost thanks you and fades away. You feel a little tougher: max HP +2.

port.npc.ghost.echo.value: A ghostly voice echoes: "My bones... find me..."

port.npc.blacksmith.offer.value: The troll rumbles: "Bring my pick back with 15 dark gold, and I shall reforge your gear."

port.npc.blacksmith.bloodoffer.value: The troll snarls: "Stain my pickaxe with bat blood, and I shall reforge your gear."

port.npc.blacksmith.done.value: The troll waves you off. "Get lost - the forge is cooling."

port.npc.blacksmith.remind.value: The troll grunts: "Pickaxe and 15 dark gold. You carry {gold}."

port.npc.blacksmith.bloodremind.value: The troll grunts: "Use my pickaxe to kill a bat, then bring it back stained with blood."

port.log.pickaxeblood.value: The pickaxe is stained with bat blood.

port.npc.blacksmith.reward.value: The forge roars! Your gear is reforged (+{weapon} weapon, +{armor} armor).

port.npc.imp.offer.value: The imp hisses: "Bring me {count} dwarf tokens from the {enemy} and a ring is yours."

port.npc.imp.done.value: The imp is gone. Only the smell of brimstone remains.

port.npc.imp.remind.value: The imp taps its claws: "{count} tokens. You carry {held}."

port.npc.imp.reward.value: The imp cackles and vanishes, leaving a +2 cursed {ring} (cleanse it to wear!).

port.npc.wandmaker.offer.value: The wandmaker rasps: "Bring me any scroll and I shall make it worth your while."

port.npc.wandmaker.done.value: The wandmaker nods and returns to their work.

port.npc.wandmaker.remind.value: The wandmaker taps the table: "A scroll. Any scroll. Then we talk wands."
